name: Iceman
bio: The youngest of the original five, a joker whose powers turned out to be far greater than anyone assumed. Came out as gay in All-New X-Men #40 (2015), a development that reframed decades of his friendships.

continuity.name: Earth-616
continuity.description: The main Marvel Comics continuity, running continuously since Fantastic Four #1 (1961).

era.name: Silver Age (Lee/Kirby/Thomas)
era.description: X-Men #1 (1963) through the original run's cancellation at #66. The first five students and the founding Xavier/Magneto conflict.

relationships.label: Oldest friends in the franchise
relationships.summary: The two original X-Men who most often left and returned together (the Champions, the Defenders, X-Factor). Bobby came out to Hank in All-New X-Men #40 (2015) among the first to know; the Krakoan era's divergence, with Hank running X-Force's dirty work, strained but did not break it.

events.note: Both leave the X-Men to form the Champions.
Young Bobby comes out; adult Bobby follows in Uncanny X-Men #600.
